title: iOS app tap · swipe · tree return ios_tool_missing — Maestro is not installed
symptom: On an iOS simulator, app tap · app swipe · app tree stop with ios_tool_missing (no iOS control tool)
cause: simctl has no tap or screen-structure commands, so iOS control is delegated to Maestro. maestro is neither on PATH nor at ~/.maestro/bin/maestro
fix: Ask the user before installing: curl -fsSL "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
Each call starts a new Maestro (JVM) and takes 10–40 s — run long scenarios at once as the project's Maestro flow
